literal_meaning: এঁড় কাটা (testicles cut off or castration)
figurative_meaning_en: lacking manhood, a form of insult
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এঁড় কাটা লোক, কোনো সাহস নেই তার।
এই এঁড় কাটা ছেলের সঙ্গে বিবাহ করবি না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a castrated man, with no courage at all.
history: Refers to the practice of castrating animals in rural Bengali agriculture, metaphorically applied to human impotence or cowardice.
note: This idiom is vulgar and used derogatorily in informal, rural contexts.
